trial_court: Family Court, East District, Karkardooma Courts, Delhi - H.M.A. No. 309/2017
facts_of_case: Marriage of the parties was solemnized on 02.05.2008. On 30.06.2009, a son was born out of the wedlock. The respondent unilaterally left their matrimonial home with the child without informing or seeking the appellant's consent.

legal_principles.principle: The conduct of the parties is relevant in determining their willingness to maintain a marriage.
legal_principles.held: The conduct of the appellant shows that, at least, till the time he filed the petition under Section 9 of the Hindu Marriage Act, 1955, he wanted to make his marriage work.

legal_principles.principle: The court may consider the conduct of the parties in determining their willingness to maintain a marriage.
legal_principles.held: We have heard learned counsel for the parties and have gone through the documents and judgments relied upon.

outcome.final_order: The trial court's judgment and decree dated 14.08.2019 was upheld, dismissing the petition seeking divorce under Sections 13(1)(ia) and 13(1)(ib) of the Hindu Marriage Act, 1955.

keywords: Latin maxim: Nemo dat quod non habet
